title: The Long Read

episodes.title: The Night Ferry
episodes.description: A crossing that should take forty minutes is logged at six hours, and nobody aboard remembers the wait. We follow the paper trail back to one harbour office.

episodes.title: Salt in the Ledger
episodes.description: How a family of salt merchants kept two sets of books for a hundred years, and what the second set says about the town that trusted them.

episodes.title: The Lighthouse Letters
episodes.description: Forty years of letters from keepers who never met, passed along the coast one relief boat at a time.

episodes.title: A Map With No Roads
episodes.description: An atlas printed in 1911 shows a valley that was never surveyed. Someone walked it anyway, and left notes in the margins.

episodes.title: Weather for Ships
episodes.description: The shipping forecast, read four times a day for a century, and the people who still set their evenings by it.

about: One story a week, told slowly. The Long Read takes a single object, place or document and follows it as far as it goes: ledgers, logbooks, maps and letters, and the people who kept them. Each episode is reported over months and runs about an hour, with no ads and no rush.
